name: singlet_clustering_cluster_significance_testing
title: Validate clusters and splits against a single-population null
description: Tests each split of a candidate partition against a null of one homogeneous population and returns a validated partition with unsupported splits removed or merged, plus a per-node table of raw and adjusted p-values. The default method countsplit re-derives fold-1 labels from the stored recipe and tests each node on held-out fold 2 with a count model. Use it before annotating clusters. Do not use it to set granularity or to judge biological distinctness, because large cell counts make trivial differences significant; de_merge is an uncalibrated heuristic kept as a comparator.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

partition_key.description: obs column holding the candidate labels; the recipe in uns/<key>/params must exist.

method.description: countsplit (default) is calibrated under its count model; de_merge is a heuristic comparator without calibration.

alpha.description: Significance level for each node test; the threshold is adjusted by p_adjust.

p_adjust.description: Adjustment across tree nodes; bonferroni controls the family-wise false split rate.

seed.description: Seed for fold assignment, permutations and null simulation.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

countsplit.description: Options for method countsplit (binomial thinning into folds, Neufeld et al. semantics).

folds.description: Number of count-split folds; each fold gets an equal share of the counts.

dispersion.description: nb fits per-gene overdispersion; poisson assumes none and is exact only for Poisson counts.

choir.description: Options for method choir (random-forest permutation tests on sibling clusters).

n_iterations.description: Label permutations for the null; run time grows with this value.

feature_set.description: Train classifiers on variable features (var) or on all features (all).

exclude_features.description: Feature names removed before classification, for example mitochondrial or ambient genes.

clusterde.description: Options for method clusterde (synthetic one-cluster null with contrast-based FDR).

null_family.description: Count family of the synthetic one-cluster null; nb is the package default.

n_pcs.description: Principal components used when building the synthetic null.

fdr.description: False discovery rate used to call genes from the target-minus-null contrast.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/leiden_validated. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, nodes_tested, splits_retained, clusters_before, clusters_after, alpha, p_adjust.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
